title: The Mirror Maze
text: A maze of mirrors where the reflections walk a step behind you, always a heartbeat slow. Except one. One of the reflections is a step ahead, and it keeps glancing back over its shoulder at you, as if to see if you are following.

options.label: The sharpest eye follows the reflection that walks ahead.

outcomes.text: It leads you out the far side, and waves.
It leads you to its friends, and they step out of the glass.

options.label: Smash your way through the mirrors.

outcomes.text: Glass everywhere, and blood on every hand, and the reflections laughing in the shards.
It walks into a mirror and does not come out, and the glass goes dark behind it.
